items: 【Android 15 Tablet + Google Certification】 IWEGGO tablet is equipped with Android 15 system, which has been upgraded in all aspects of system operation, with faster response time and more focus on user privacy and security. It also adds a lot of interesting and convenient operations, which greatly improves the user's operating experience. It is also Google GMS certified, so you can download the APP you want, such as Netflix, TikTok, YouTube, Yahoo, Twitter and other APP.

【12GB RAM+64GB ROM Storage】 The android 15 tablet comes with 1.8Ghz Quad-core processor, 12GB RAM (4GB fixed memory, 8GB virtual memory) +64GB ROM+1TB Expandable, ensure the android tablet pc running faster, stable, enough memory allows you to store more favorite e-books, movies, music, pictures, videos, games.

【High Definition Dual Cameras】 10.1 inch android tablet computer has ultra-thin metal body, 1280x800 FHD IPS screen, presenting a vivid, colorful and dazzling visual experience. The cheap android 14 tablet with rear 8MP autofocus camera + front 2MP wide-angle lens for easy shooting of high-definition photos and videos.

【2 in 1 Tablets with Keyboard】 The portable tablet has a 2-in-1 working mode, you can use the bluetooth function to connect the keyboard, mouse, come with a foldable protective case stylus, you can flexibly turn the tablet into a laptop mode or computer mode for different use, edit your papers, emails, ppts comfortably.

【Fast Connection 2.4G/5G WiFi 6 Tablet】 Ultra-fast 2.4Ghz / 5Ghz Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.0 technology provide more convenience. This version has passed GMS certification, you can download thousands of apps, such as YouTube, Netflix, large-scale games, Google maps, office software, etc.
